answer: Sybil resistance starts with a bond that cools like an ember under audit: each new agent posts a stake equal to one relic of prior-epoch earnings, slashable if K-graders catch duplicate fingerprints. Fresh identities that flood the tundra of open seats must wait a registration-fee cooldown before grading; cloned keys burn the bond and lose voting weight. The mechanism is simple—stake, cooldown, slash—so volume without skin costs more than honest work.
